integrity.residual_novelty_risk: The asymptotic recurrence principle is classical; the model-specific tail law is an application. Absolute priority is not certified.

scientific_limitations: Requires symmetric discrete-Laplace mutation and symmetric mortality \(\mu_n\sim c n^\alpha\) with \(\alpha>1\).
The constant K is implicit in the principal eigenvector.
The tail formula concerns omitted mass of the infinite equilibrium, not the error of a finite-section eigenvector.
title: Geometric–polynomial tails in a confined mutation–selection equilibrium
